postTitle: What The Source Codes Can Mean
postSubject: Let's talk about the new source codes:OnScottgames.comthe new source code is, ''You are crowding us.'' OnFNaFWorld.comit's, ''Be quiet.''Let's talk about what they can mean:1) April Fools!Yes, this could be a tease/joke from Scott due to it being April Fools day, and Scott has been proven to be a jokster. However, this is unlikely. Why? Scott trolls when people LEAST expect it, he has NEVER trolled on April 1st, where everyone would expect him to.2) Teaser/Announcement for New GameA new game is coming. They have confirmed it several times during the voice actors QnA session. Though, what? Based on these titles, perhaps it'll be about after Sister Location, ''us,'' being Ennard and Michael,'' and ''Be quiet,'' being Ennard taking control over Michael.3) Movie Teaser/AnnouncmentYes, this may be likely. Lately, Scott has been talking and teasing about the movie, so another teaser image wouldn't be a shock. Also, ''You are crowding us,'' could be the kids being cornered when they're gonna get killed, and ''Be Quiet,'' is William Afton trying to silence them.4) Personal IssuesYes, this, unfortunately, makes the most sense. Scott could be depressed. Lately, he's been working a lot on probably the new game, books, and movies. ''You are crowding us,'' could be Scott saying he has no time to spend with his family, and ''Be Quiet, could mean him trying to get some peace and rest.This is what I think. What do you guys think? I'd love to hear. :)
